note: Word pairs that differ in one sound. Every word is a DMII Core form; the synthetic voice was checked to produce a different phoneme string for the two words of each pair. The contrasts are listed with their sources in content/CLAIMS.md.

length.en: Long or short? A vowel is long before a single consonant and short before a double one: man has a long a, mann a short a and a long n.
length.nb: Lang eller kort? En vokal er lang foran én konsonant og kort foran dobbel konsonant: man har lang a, mann kort a og lang n.

preaspiration.en: Breath before the stop: in takk and hattur a puff of air (an h sound) comes before the k or t.
preaspiration.nb: Pust før lukkelyden: i takk og hattur kommer et pust (en h-lyd) foran k eller t.

ll.en: Double l sounds like tl: halla sounds roughly like "hatla".
ll.nb: Dobbel l uttales omtrent som tl: halla høres ut som «hatla».
